conviction_note: Q3 and a possible narrowing of the FY26 guide are new on the day (no ad-hoc since 7 Aug), so the move is sized on the new-numbers/guidance scale for a liquid, low-vol DAX name (5.0%). The lean is mildly positive: peers accelerated in Q3 and BASF reported prices +12%, against a sell-side that previewed a fade (DB 378m, 'slightly below consensus'). It is held near 50 because those peer facts have been public for 1-3 weeks without moving the stock, because free cash flow is a credible offsetting negative, and because the Capital Markets Day the next day may hold back the reaction. impact_sum (+1.3) is larger than the scaled +0.5 because each finding is sized on its own and the FCF negative only partly offsets the pricing-driven positives.

findings.finding: Chemical-distribution peers that reported after Brenntag last spoke accelerated in Q3 2026: Azelis organic adjusted EBITA +14.3% (organic growth +8.2% in Q3 against +2.8% for 9M), IMCD Q3 organic EBITA +14% 'with contributions from all regions'. This cuts against the sell-side preview that Q2's pricing and inventory tailwind faded in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 beat pre-released by ad-hoc on 22 June; the 12 Aug final results day moved -2.18% (estimated history); Q3 2025 day +4.44% (estimated).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: both have been public for 5-19 days. But BNR is -2.8% over 20 days and about 6% below its 7 Aug level of 65.68, and the newest previews (Jefferies 27.09 'what goes up must come down', DB 01.10 below consensus, JPM 24.09 'tailwind fading') all predate both peer prints. If the market had read the peers through to Brenntag, the stock would have rerated and the previews would have been revised upward; the stock did not move and no revision is visible.
findings.independence: Azelis Q3, 22.10.2026, https://www.ideal-investisseur.fr/en/actions-b/azelis-8-2-organic-growth-in-third-quarter-but-free-cash-flow-sharply-declines/27692.html ; also JPM raised short-term estimates on 'a better start of most of the sector into Q3' (27.08.2026)

findings.finding: BASF, an upstream supplier whose prices feed Brenntag's Essentials margin, reported Q3 2026 prices +12% and volumes +2% year on year, EBITDA bSI +15%, and raised its FY26 range to EUR 7.4-7.8bn. Chemical pricing had not normalised in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 Essentials op. EBITDA +47% on higher chemical pricing, and the stock rallied to its highest since March 2025 on the 7 Aug raise.
findings.why_not_priced: Macro-to-company transmission, so this is a hypothesis: a year-on-year price level does not establish the sequential price change that drives a distributor's inventory gains. It is public. Sized small because it only corroborates the peer finding.
findings.independence: Different source from the peer finding (a producer rather than distributors), same mechanism, so sized down rather than merged.

findings.finding: Brenntag used MAR ad-hocs twice in 2026 when results ran ahead of expectations, and has filed none on Q3 since 7 Aug. That implies Q3 has not deviated materially from the market's bar in either direction, which caps the quarter-level surprise.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 22.06.2026 ad-hoc: preliminary Q2 'above current market expectations', guide raised; 07.08.2026 ad-hoc: guide raised again, stock up to 66.68 intraday.
findings.why_not_priced: Constrains size, not sign: it cuts both tails equally, so it carries no direction. It enters abs_move_pct and p_up rather than the sum.

findings.finding: Guidance arithmetic: H1 op. EBITDA 769m (306m + 463m) plus a ~380m Q3 gives about 1,150m year to date. The 1,400m midpoint then needs only ~250m in Q4, below Q4 2025's 268m (FY25 1,287m less 9M 1,019m). A narrowing to the upper half of 1,350-1,450m is therefore the likely guide action, above the 1.38bn analyst average of August.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 7 Aug 2026 guide raise: +1.6% intraday, briefly higher; May 2026 guide confirmation after a weak Q1: +3.22% (estimated history).
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus as of 7 Aug sat below the guide's midpoint, and the previews (UBS 21.08 'Rückenwind ... im zweiten Halbjahr abschwächen', JPM) price an H2 fade. If an upper-half narrowing were expected, the stock would not sit 6% below its August level. The risk is that management frames Q4 cautiously ahead of the CMD (the Q2 release said 'risks of demand weakness remain').
findings.independence: FY25 base: https://www.brenntag.com/en-de/media/news/brenntag-se-publishes-preliminary-results-for-the-fiscal-year-2025.html ; Q1 2026 306m: https://www.brenntag.com/en-de/media/news/brenntag-reports-q1-2026-financial-results.html. This rests partly on the same pricing mechanism as the two findings above.

EBITDA 378m, below consensus), Jefferies Hold (TP 56, 'Was hochgeht, muss auch wieder herunterkommen'), JPM Underweight (Middle East tailwind fading, 'mittelfristige Gewinnziele ... ambitioniert'), UBS Neutral. The stock has given back about 6% since 7 Aug.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 statement day +4.44% (estimated history) from a depressed base.
findings.original_quote: "Was hochgeht, muss auch wieder herunterkommen", schrieb Marcus Dunford-Castro am Samstag in seinem Ausblick auf den Quartalsbericht. Er geht davon aus, dass der Rückenwind bei Lagerbeständen und Preisen aus dem zweiten Quartal nachgelassen hat. ["What goes up must come down" ... he assumes the inventory and pricing tailwind from Q2 has faded.]
findings.why_not_priced: The previews are themselves priced, since they are wire copy. The finding is that they set a low bar, so an in-line print skews toward relief. Small for that reason.

findings.finding: Supervisory board member Dr. Claudine Mollenkopf bought EUR 21,540 of shares at an average EUR 59.83 on 6 Oct 2026, inside the pre-results period.
findings.why_not_priced: Too small to be a signal, and a supervisory board member is not management. Filed because it is a sourced fact; sized near zero.

findings.finding: Free cash flow is the likely weak line. Q2 2026 FCF was EUR 4m (Q2 2025: 154m) on working capital at higher prices, and net financial liabilities rose to EUR 3,100m. In Q3 Azelis reported free cash flow 'sharply declines' with inventory days at 59, and BASF tied up EUR 507m in inventories on higher raw-material prices.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 12 Aug 2026 (Q2 final with the EUR 4m FCF): -2.18% (estimated history), on a day whose EBITDA was already pre-released.
findings.why_not_priced: The previews focus on EBITDA fade and none of the visible notes addresses cash. Brenntag's investment case and dividend rest on FCF (FY25 941m). The company called the Q2 hit 'technical', which the market may not accept twice.
